# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, but the slimmest banks top out at 15W or less. So the choice is between thinness and charging speed.

## Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)
- **Buy:** [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), listed at $54.99
- **Specs:** 0.34" thick, 4.3 oz, 5,000mAh, Qi2-certified 15W wireless, 20W wired USB-C
- **Why:** Anker markets it for the iPhone 17 series. 9to5Mac's reviewer called it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and said it feels premium and runs cooler than competitors ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
- **Trade-off:** 5K typically gets you about 60-75% of a charge ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

## Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71
- **Specs:** 0.27" thick, 104g, 5,000mAh, 22.5W wired
- **Price:** About $52.99 at Amazon ([Android Central review with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **Trade-off:** Android Central lists its wireless speed at only 7.5W, so it is slower than the Anker for wireless top-ups.

## Slim with more capacity and 25W: INIU SnapGo Air 10K
- **Specs:** 10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2 wireless (full speed on iPhone 17), 45W wired, about 0.5" thick, 195g, with a built-in lanyard-style cable
- **Price:** About $42.99 at Amazon ([Android Central, with buy links](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **Why:** Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K power bank, with a digital display ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)). It's the best fit if you want a full charge or more but still want something slim.
- **Trade-off:** No kickstand.

## Other options
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W, IP54 water and dust resistance):** about 0.57" thick, $69.99-$79.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **UGREEN MagFlow Pro 10K:** Macworld's pick for best capacity test score and also an equal-slimmest 10K, with 25W wireless and 45W wired ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

## Which to choose
- **Pocketable and thin, and 15W is fine:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **Thinnest possible, and slow wireless is OK:** Baseus Picogo Air.
- **Fastest charging and a full charge or more in a slim body:** INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

**Case note:** Anker says non-magnetic cases, or cases thicker than about 2.5mm, can weaken the connection. Metal attachments like cards or pop grips also interfere.

I couldn't check live prices or stock, so confirm the price at checkout.
